screen.wildercord.passive.rules: Self or Orbit, then lasting buffs (Swift, Stoneskin, Infinity, Reflect...). Damage like Shock or Dismantle needs an Orbit to carry it. No links and no cooldown: it costs mana every second instead.

modmenu.descriptionTranslation.wildercor: Thread simple runes onto a Cord in any order, then cast the whole sequence with one key.
rune.wildercord.touch.desc: Targets what you're looking at, within reach.
rune.wildercord.bolt.desc: Fires a flying bolt, up to 48 blocks.
rune.wildercord.beam.desc: An instant line that hits the first thing within 24 blocks.
rune.wildercord.zone.desc: A 3-block field where you look. Re-applies every second for 6 seconds.
rune.wildercord.rain.desc: 5 strikes from the sky over 2 seconds, around where you look.
rune.wildercord.arc.desc: Lobs a bolt that falls and bursts where it lands.
rune.wildercord.cone.desc: Sweeps everything in a 60-degree cone up to 6 blocks in front of you.
rune.wildercord.trail.desc: For 5 seconds your footsteps leave a path that hits whatever steps on it.
rune.wildercord.wall.desc: A 7-block wall across where you look. Hits whatever crosses it for 5 seconds.
rune.wildercord.orbit.desc: Three orbs circle you for 8 seconds and hit whatever they touch.
rune.wildercord.ring.desc: A ring expands from you out to 7 blocks, hitting everything it passes.
rune.wildercord.pillar.desc: A column erupts where you look: hits everything within 1.5 blocks, 6 high.
rune.wildercord.wave.desc: A 3-wide wave rolls 14 blocks forward along the ground.
rune.wildercord.mine.desc: Hides a rune where you look. It fires when an enemy steps near (lasts 30 seconds).
rune.wildercord.totem.desc: A floating totem where you look pulses every 2 seconds for 10 seconds.
rune.wildercord.domain.desc: Expands a 9-block domain around you for 6 seconds. Every second everything inside is struck, and enemies inside are slowed.
rune.wildercord.crescent.desc: A crescent slash flies 16 blocks forward, cutting everything in its 5-wide path.
rune.wildercord.barrage.desc: A flurry of 8 blows in one second on everything right in front of you, each at 35% power.
rune.wildercord.orb.desc: A slow, heavy orb drifts 20 blocks forward through creatures, striking everything within 2 blocks of it once a second.
rune.wildercord.blitz.desc: You flash up to 8 blocks forward in an instant, striking everything you pass through.
rune.wildercord.feather_fall.desc: Slow falling and no fall damage for 12 seconds.
rune.wildercord.push.desc: Hurls targets away from the spell.
rune.wildercord.light.desc: A light source at the point for 60 seconds.
rune.wildercord.grow.desc: Bone-meals the block that was hit and everything around it.
rune.wildercord.launch.desc: Flings targets high into the air. On Self it rockets you up and forward.
rune.wildercord.dash.desc: Shoves targets hard the way you're facing. On Self it's a long dash.
rune.wildercord.fire.desc: 5 fire damage and sets alight for 6 seconds.
rune.wildercord.frost.desc: 5 freeze damage, freezes solid and Slowness III for 4 seconds.
rune.wildercord.break.desc: Mines the block that was hit (up to iron-pickaxe hardness; Amplify for diamond).
rune.wildercord.lightning.desc: A 12-damage lightning strike on each target that stuns and burns. You and your allies are immune.
rune.wildercord.blink.desc: Teleports you to where the spell landed (max 40 blocks).
rune.wildercord.explode.desc: 12 damage in a 3.5-block blast. Never breaks blocks.
rune.wildercord.dragon_breath.desc: A lingering 3-block cloud: 5 damage per second for 5 seconds.
rune.wildercord.shock.desc: 4 lightning damage that arcs to one more enemy nearby.
rune.wildercord.haste.desc: Haste II for 30 seconds: mine and swing faster.
rune.wildercord.reveal.desc: Makes targets glow through walls for 15 seconds.
rune.wildercord.cleanse.desc: Washes away harmful effects and fire.
rune.wildercord.root.desc: Vines hold targets in place for 3 seconds.
rune.wildercord.veil.desc: Invisibility for 12 seconds, and nearby monsters lose track of you.
rune.wildercord.levitate.desc: Targets float helplessly upward for 3 seconds. On Self you float.
rune.wildercord.freeze.desc: Freezes targets solid for 2.5 seconds: they can't move or fight back.
rune.wildercord.meteor.desc: A burning meteor falls on each target: 10 damage in a 3-block blast.
rune.wildercord.tremor.desc: The ground erupts: 8 damage to enemies within 4 blocks, throwing them up.
rune.wildercord.gravity_well.desc: Drags every enemy within 7 blocks into the point for 2 seconds.
rune.wildercord.summon.desc: Three spirit wolves fight at your side for 20 seconds.
rune.wildercord.venom.desc: Poison II for 6 seconds and 2 damage.
rune.wildercord.inferno.desc: Everything within 4 blocks burns: 3 fire damage a second for 4 seconds.
rune.wildercord.thunderclap.desc: A crack of thunder: 5 damage and a heavy knockback within 3 blocks.
rune.wildercord.starfall.desc: Eight falling stars around the point over 2 seconds: 6 damage each.
rune.wildercord.chill.desc: Slowness II for 6 seconds and 1 freeze damage.
rune.wildercord.silence.desc: Monsters forget their target and are weakened for 6 seconds.
rune.wildercord.tidebreath.desc: Water breathing and faster swimming for 30 seconds.
rune.wildercord.grapple.desc: Pulls you to where the spell hit.
rune.wildercord.harvest.desc: Harvests grown crops around the block hit, and replants them.
rune.wildercord.icepath.desc: Freezes water within 3 blocks into ice you can walk on.
rune.wildercord.collect.desc: Pulls items and experience within 8 blocks to you.
rune.wildercord.excavate.desc: Mines a 3x3 area of blocks (up to iron-pickaxe hardness; Amplify for diamond).
rune.wildercord.cleave.desc: Cuts in proportion to the target: 4 damage plus 12% of its max health (up to 30 more).
rune.wildercord.dismantle.desc: Three unseen slashes a tenth of a second apart: 3 damage each, straight through armour.
rune.wildercord.blackspark.desc: 8 damage. One hit in four sparks black: 2.5x damage, and you're in the zone (Strength and Speed) for 6 seconds.
rune.wildercord.aftershock.desc: 5 damage, then a second impact half a second later for 5 more.
rune.wildercord.resonance.desc: 4 damage and a cursed mark for 10 seconds. Every other marked enemy within 16 blocks takes half of it too.
rune.wildercord.ripple.desc: Sunlight through the body: 6 damage, tripled against undead, and heals you for a third of it.
rune.wildercord.primer.desc: Turns each target into a bomb that goes off 2 seconds later: 10 damage within 3 blocks. Never breaks blocks.
rune.wildercord.blackflame.desc: Black flames that water can't put out: 3 damage a second for 6 seconds. If the target dies burning, they spread.
rune.wildercord.hollow.desc: Erases what it touches: 20 damage, and everything within 4 blocks is dragged into the gap for 8 more.
rune.wildercord.repel.desc: A violent outward blast: 5 damage and hurls everything within 3 blocks away. On enemies just pulled in, it sets off Collapse.
rune.wildercord.decree.desc: A spoken command: everything hit is stunned for 2 seconds. Speaking it costs you 2 health per cast.
rune.wildercord.weigh.desc: Crushingly heavy for 5 seconds: triple gravity, barely able to move or jump, and fliers are dragged down.
rune.wildercord.shackle.desc: Chains each target to the spot for 5 seconds: it's yanked back if it strays more than 2 blocks.
rune.wildercord.bubble.desc: Traps targets in a floating bubble for 3 seconds. It pops for 4 damage and leaves them soaked.
rune.wildercord.infinity.desc: For 6 seconds nothing reaches you: projectiles slow to a stop in the air and enemies that come too close are pushed back.
rune.wildercord.reversal.desc: For 30 seconds, one killing blow is reversed: back to half health instead of dying.
rune.wildercord.reflect.desc: For 10 seconds, whatever hurts the target takes 60% of the damage back.
rune.wildercord.overdrive.desc: Past your limits for 10 seconds: Strength II, Speed II and Haste II, but you lose 1 health every 2 seconds.
rune.wildercord.foresight.desc: Sees the next 2 attacks coming (for 15 seconds): each is dodged with a sidestep.
rune.wildercord.restore.desc: Puts things back: heals 6, puts out fire, and mends 5% of every worn and held item's durability.
rune.wildercord.swap.desc: You and the first creature hit trade places, instantly.
rune.wildercord.zipper.desc: Unzips the wall in front of you and steps you through up to 6 blocks of solid wall.
rune.wildercord.shadowstep.desc: You vanish and reappear right behind the first creature hit, facing its back.
rune.wildercord.stasis.desc: Time stops for everything hit for 5 seconds. Every hit meanwhile is held, then lands all at once when time moves again.
rune.wildercord.rewind.desc: Turns back the clock: return to where you were 5 seconds ago, with the health you had then if it was more.
rune.wildercord.accelerate.desc: Time runs faster for 10 seconds: Speed III, Haste III, Jump Boost II and Regeneration.
rune.wildercord.time_skip.desc: Time skips ahead: you vanish, reappear up to 8 blocks forward, and nearby monsters lose track of you.
rune.wildercord.rampart.desc: Raises a 5-wide, 3-high wall of earth at the point for 10 seconds.
rune.wildercord.shades.desc: Two shadow hounds rise from your shadow and hunt at your side for 20 seconds.
rune.wildercord.thunderbird.desc: A storm bird circles above you for 15 seconds, striking the nearest enemy within 12 blocks every 1.5 seconds.
rune.wildercord.blood_thread.desc: Threads everything hit together for 8 seconds: half of any damage one of them takes is dealt to the rest.
rune.wildercord.kindling.desc: 3 fire damage and a stack of Kindling. The fifth stack ignites: 10 damage in a 3-block burst.
rune.wildercord.twin_star.desc: Your next spell within 6 seconds is cast twice.
rune.wildercord.borrowed_time.desc: Heals every bit of damage you took in the last 5 seconds. Over the next 10 seconds it comes back, unless you slay something.
rune.wildercord.gale_mantle.desc: For 12 seconds, jump again in midair to dash forward (up to 3 dashes).
rune.wildercord.stoneform.desc: For 8 seconds: no knockback, 20% less damage, and every hit you take sends out an aftershock.
rune.wildercord.mirrorfrost.desc: Casts back the last spell that hit you in the past 30 seconds, as your own.
rune.wildercord.fortune.desc: For 10 seconds, every hit you deal has a 1 in 4 chance to strike for triple.
rune.wildercord.phantom.desc: Leaves an afterimage of you that every monster within 16 blocks turns on for 4 seconds, then it bursts for 8 damage.
rune.wildercord.stormheart.desc: For 10 seconds, whatever hits you is struck by lightning (at most once a second).
rune.wildercord.quicken.desc: Bolts fly twice as fast; delays are halved.
rune.wildercord.bounce.desc: Bounces off blocks up to 3 times.
rune.wildercord.homing.desc: Steers toward the nearest enemy within 12 blocks.
rune.wildercord.chain.desc: After a hit, jumps to up to 3 more enemies within 6 blocks.
rune.wildercord.frugal.desc: Half the mana, but 40% weaker and shorter.
rune.wildercord.linger.desc: The effect lands twice more, a second apart.
rune.wildercord.volley.desc: Fires three times in quick succession.
rune.wildercord.vow.desc: A binding vow: the shape's effects hit twice as hard, but the whole spell's cooldown is 4x longer.
rune.wildercord.blood_price.desc: Pay for the whole spell in health instead of mana: 1 health per 5 mana. Never lethal.
rune.wildercord.execute.desc: Double power against targets under half health.
rune.wildercord.delay.desc: The rest fires 1 second later, from you.
rune.wildercord.on_hit.desc: The rest fires wherever the shape before it hits.
rune.wildercord.on_land.desc: The rest fires when you next touch the ground.
rune.wildercord.on_kill.desc: The rest fires at each creature the shape before it kills.
rune.wildercord.echo.desc: Everything before it fires again 0.5 seconds later.
rune.wildercord.pulse.desc: The rest fires three times, one second apart, from you.
rune.wildercord.on_hurt.desc: The rest fires at whatever next hurts you (within 15 seconds).
rune.wildercord.if_sneaking.desc: The rest fires only if you're sneaking. Build two spells in one.
rune.wildercord.on_low_health.desc: The rest fires when your health drops below 30% (within 30 seconds).
rune.wildercord.if_airborne.desc: The rest fires only if you're in the air. Build aerial finishers.
rune.wildercord.combo.desc: The rest fires only on every third cast of this spell: a finisher.

command.wildercord.runebound: Bound a Cord to the nearest monster
tooltip.wildercord.scroll_blank: Inscribe a spell from the Cord screen
tooltip.wildercord.scroll_use: Right-click to cast it once. No Cord needed
tooltip.wildercord.torn_page: Right-click to read the riddle of a secret spell
tooltip.wildercord.training_dummy: Place it and try your spells: it shows every hit and your damage per second. Sneak and punch it to pick it up
message.wildercord.overcast_prompt: Not enough mana (%s/%s). Cast again to overcast: your %s Circle cracks for 3 minutes
message.wildercord.overcast: Overcast! Your %s Circle cracks. It mends in %s minutes
message.wildercord.leaning: Your magic leans toward %s: its spells hit a little harder, and your circles take its colour.
message.wildercord.innate: Your innate rune awakens: %s. It's in your Codex, and it grows with every circle.
message.wildercord.innate_item: An innate rune can't be learned from an item
message.wildercord.borrowed: Borrowed %s health. Slay something, or it comes back
message.wildercord.nothing_to_mirror: No spell has hit you lately
reaction.wildercord.shatter.desc: Fire on a frozen target: +60% damage, and the ice bursts.
reaction.wildercord.conduct.desc: Storm on a wet or soaked target: +50% damage, arcing to two more.
reaction.wildercord.wildfire.desc: Fire on a target just thrown by wind: flames spread to everything around it.
reaction.wildercord.implode.desc: A blast where enemies were just pulled together: 50% wider, 30% harder.
reaction.wildercord.collapse.desc: Repel on enemies just pulled in: double damage.
chat.wildercord.spell_copy: Click to copy the code, then paste it in the Cord screen
message.wildercord.ley_first: You stand on a ley line, where the world's mana runs close to the surface. Mana flows twice as fast here, and circles form twice as quickly. A Wellstone set on one becomes a well for everyone near it.
message.wildercord.ley_on: A ley line runs beneath you
screen.wildercord.mana.way.ley: Stand on a ley line (Cord-wearers see its violet motes), or set a Wellstone on one
message.wildercord.archivist_wakes: Pages stir. The Archivist rises from its lectern.
message.wildercord.archivist_rewrites.2: The Archivist tears out a page and rewrites its Cord.
message.wildercord.archivist_rewrites.3: The Archivist burns its last pages. Its Cord blazes with new runes.
message.wildercord.page_nothing: Nothing on this page you don't already know
message.wildercord.page_read: The page is torn, but a riddle survives:
message.wildercord.page_map: In the margin, a map: an Archive lies about %s blocks to the %s.
message.wildercord.scroll_needs: Inscribing a scroll takes paper and an ink sac
message.wildercord.scroll_mana: Inscribing costs twice the spell's mana (%s/%s)
message.wildercord.code_none: No spell code (wc:...) on the clipboard
message.wildercord.code_partial: Loaded, but %s rune(s) left out: not known, too strong, or no socket free
screen.wildercord.tool.rename.hint: Give this spell a name. Enter saves; an empty name goes back to the automatic one
screen.wildercord.tool.copy.hint: Paste the code in chat and everyone can read the spell
screen.wildercord.tool.paste.hint: Load a copied code into this spell (runes you know, that this Cord holds)
screen.wildercord.tool.scroll.hint: Write this spell onto a scroll anyone can cast once. Takes paper, an ink sac and twice the mana
screen.wildercord.grimoire.innate_none: Innate rune: wakes at the 1st Circle
screen.wildercord.grimoire.leaning_none: Leaning: none yet (cast one element %s times, more than the rest)
screen.wildercord.grimoire.secret_unknow: Some exact rune sequences are secret spells. Torn Pages hold their riddles.
screen.wildercord.heart.cracked: Cracked by overcasting: %s circle(s), mending in %s
